varta.md avoid list checked against every topic_name, segment_name, module_name, concept_name and objective_text present at this stage. (1) no summary-only phrasing — objectives ask for motive and craft, not retelling; (2) no tacked-on બોધ — no 'આ વાર્તા આપણને શીખવે છે…' / 'આપણે પણ … જોઈએ' construction anywhere; (3) no evaluative label applied to a sympathetic character — the father's forgetfulness is never named as ભુલકણો in an objective, and O3 was visibly re-worded away from it; (4) the turn is not spoiled early — no name or objective before M3.S6.T10 mentions the box on the back seat, the mother's instruction, or that the system was already collected; (5) no પૌરાણિક debunking (n/a); (6) no dialect standardising (n/a — no તળપદી લોકકથા register here); (7) not an excerpt, so no invented resolution; (8) attribution is '- સંકલિત', no translator credit to mis-assign.
